effects: Sends the signer's unclaimed rewards in `token` from the Rewards V2 contract to `recipient`. The type is Vault snapshot or Cumulative Merkle, set by the first 8 bytes of `data`.
Snapshot type: claims the signer's share of the distributions of the vault inside `data` for the network inside `data`, and moves the signer's claim index forward.
Merkle type: pays the cumulative amount inside `data`, less what was already claimed, after a Merkle proof check, and records the new claimed total.
No native value and no approval. Inferred from the calldata layout and the test descriptions only: the implementation source is not in the directory.
formats.shown: "Claim {token} to {recipient}", with the contract, recipient, reward token, the reward type taken from data[0:8], the network from data[20:40], and the full claim data as a raw hex blob.

findings.title: claimRewards: the snapshot vault and the Merkle cumulative amount appear only inside the raw claim data.
findings.evidence: Cases 5–7: the vault (e.g. 0xc10a7f0a…) sits at data[52:72]. Case 4: the cumulative amount 0x0bebc200 (200 USDC) sits at data[136:168]. In snapshot cases, data[136:168] holds rewardsToClaim instead. Descriptor: only `#.data.[0:8]`, `#.data.[20:40]` and `#.data` (raw) are fields.
findings.fix: The data layout depends on the reward type, and ERC-7730 has no conditional fields, so no single slice can be labeled correctly for both types. Ask the contract to expose separate typed entry points, or wait for conditional display in the spec.

findings.title: claimRewards: 'Claim data' shows 200–330 bytes of hex that a signer cannot read.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json claimRewards field `#.data` label 'Claim data' format raw visible always. Case 2's screen shows a 0x0000000000000001…aaaa…bbbb blob.
findings.fix: Set `visible: never` on the raw blob, or move it to an optional field. Keep the decoded type and network fields.

findings.title: claimRewards: the reward-type and network slice offsets could not be checked against the implementation.
findings.evidence: meta.json constructor `_logic` = 0xa73501536B35DeF71C3B68273f6FAff83c01630f, which has no source in contracts/. Descriptor slices `#.data.[0:8]` as the enum and `#.data.[20:40]` as the network.
findings.fix: Verify the implementation on Sourcify so that the decoding of `data` can be confirmed.
